title: Transport from a shifted strict root system to an exact functor image
statement: For exact additive F:A→B between abelian categories with derived categories, an object N of A, an object H of B, J in D(B), b:J≅H[2] and e:H≅F(N), define rootSystemTransport to be b followed by single(e)[2], the inverse exact single comparison shifted by two, and the inverse shift comparison for D(F). Its target is D(F)(N[2]). All comparisons are the existing canonical ones of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and [def-sp-tower-class-reduction].

def rootSystemTransport
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Abelian A] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (N : A) {H : B} {J : DerivedCategory B}
    (b : J ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).obj H)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (e : H ≅ F.obj N) :
    J ≅ F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj N)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
